title: Plucking seven notes with four plucks, and fast tempos
summary: On tape he plays a run where open strings and left-hand hits make seven notes from four plucks, and shows tempos like I've Got Rhythm.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Now, you were showing -- you were mentioning a little while ago when we were talking about -- that there's a way that you figured out to play seven notes, but only fingering -- what was it? You pluck four and play seven?
Would you play that for the tape here?

It was a little run when I think I did it like this. (Playing bass.) I start on B natural and end up on C. (Playing bass.) Now I plucked all of those notes, but I'm going to steal a little bit and only pluck those seven notes four times in my run. I'm going to pluck four times, like (playing bass.) I hit the open string with my finger on my left hand and I pluck again my F (playing bass) E and hit the D, open D, with my left finger and then my C. (Playing bass.)
Uh-huh. Now is that a thing that you used a lot in those years or was that something that you begun (inaudible)?
Well, something that I developed as I was going along.

(Inaudible) even think about it that way, but there is -- what do you call it? I steal quite a lot of times, you know, when I'm playing. Like playing a fast tempo on a number like 'I've Got Rhythm,' real fast, like the

tempo will go up to about this speed -- (playing bass.) I'm playing two-four this time to start off with, two-four. Now I'll go up to four-four -- (playing.) You know, four-four, like I was playing it then, wasn't too fast. We used to go even a little faster than that. Now, let's speed up the tempo, like in B-flat, 'I've Got Rhythm,' maybe, to start that off. (Singing.) Let's do it a little faster this time. (Playing bass.) That's two-four. Now, four-four. (Playing bass.) Like that, you know. And more or less, that was the tempo that we were used to playing, you know, a lot of numbers would have that speed, you know.
Now it has been played much faster. Now let's see if we can do it a little faster, at my day and age, what I mean? (Playing bass.) You know?
